items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Joe Moritz, who did I insult the most? [INTERVIEWEE] Well we did a session with Joe Avery and Louis Barbrun...

ctx.x: Joe Wiggs is good, he loved that.
Joe Moritz, who did I insult the most?

Well we did a session with Joe Avery and Louis Barbrun, or Paul Barbrun, excuse me, and a session with Sweet Emma and Percy Humphrey, and of course there was the session that was called Doc and His Patience with the two clarinets, Raymond Burke and Harry Shields, and Jeanette Kimball on piano, and there was also a tuba and a bass on that, Chink Martin and Sherwood and Japanic. Johnny St. Cyril.
